import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
      for c in range(W):
        if g[r][c]==8 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy][xx]!=8 and (yy,xx) not in seen: seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp); c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
        colored=[(y,x) for y,x in comp if g[y][x] not in (0,8)]
        if not colored: continue
        a=min(y for y,x in colored); b=max(y for y,x in colored); l=min(x for y,x in colored); rr=max(x for y,x in colored)
        ph=b-a+1; pw=rr-l+1
        pat=[[g[a+i][l+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
        # tile phase anchored to motif placement within panel
        offy=(a-r0)%ph; offx=(l-c0)%pw
        for y,x in comp:
          g[y][x]=pat[(y-r0-offy)%ph][(x-c0-offx)%pw]
    return g
'''
